lines.text: After Joshua died, the LORD chose Judah to go up first, and Judah asked the Simeonites to come along.
Judah struck down ten thousand men at Bezek, and they cut off the thumbs and big toes of Adoni-bezek.
Judah captured Jerusalem and set it on fire, then marched against the Canaanites living in Shechem.
Othniel captured Debir and married Caleb's daughter Acsah, who then asked her father for springs of water.
Judah and the Simeonites attacked Zephath and renamed it Gilgal; later Judah gave Hebron to Caleb.
